resources.string: How can we help you today?

How to use this calculator:
 1. Fill up your vehicle's tank and reset the trip odometer.
 2. Drive normally for a few days.
 3. When you fill the tank again:
 - Note the current distance traveled (since the reset).
 - Note the number of liters refueled.
 4. Enter these two values into the calculator:
 - Kilometers traveled
 - Liters refueled
 The app will automatically calculate your vehicle's average fuel consumption.

To calculate the total fuel cost of a trip, simply enter the starting and destination addresses, the vehicle\'s highway fuel efficiency in Km/L, and the fuel price.\n\n The app uses the Google Maps API to calculate the distance between addresses, so make sure you\'re connected to the internet
To use this calculator, just enter the ethanol and gasoline prices. The app will show you the best option.
